Coaches should only cancel confirmed sessions when absolutely necessary. If a coach needs to cancel, they should inform the customer as soon as possible and try to offer a suitable rescheduling option. Repeated coach cancellations may negatively affect ranking, visibility, ambassador status, or continued access to the PeakUp platform.

Customers may cancel a booking according to the timing of the cancellation. If a cancellation is made 7 or more days before the scheduled session, the customer may be eligible for a full refund. If the cancellation is made between 48 hours and 7 days before the session, the customer may be eligible for a partial refund. If the cancellation is made less than 48 hours before the session, the booking is generally non-refundable unless the coach or PeakUp approves an exception.

Exceptional events outside the control of the customer, coach or PeakUp may be reviewed individually. These may include serious illness, injury, natural events, travel disruption, resort closures, official restrictions, or other extraordinary circumstances.

If a customer does not attend a confirmed session without prior notice, the booking is generally considered non-refundable. If a coach does not attend a confirmed session without valid reason or communication, PeakUp may review the case and take appropriate action.

Refunds and payouts depend on the timing and reason for the cancellation. PeakUp may withhold, adjust or release payouts depending on the applicable cancellation rule, customer refund eligibility, and the specific circumstances of the case.

PeakUp encourages rescheduling before cancellation whenever possible. If both the customer and coach agree on a new date or time, the booking may be moved without requiring a refund. Rescheduling is especially encouraged for weather-related or operational reasons.
PeakUp reserves the right to review cancellation cases individually, especially when safety, fairness, repeated cancellations, disputes, or platform quality are involved.

Many PeakUp activities take place outdoors. If weather, snow, water, trail, lift, transport or safety conditions make the activity unsafe or impossible, the coach and customer should first try to reschedule. PeakUp may review cases involving severe weather, resort/lift closures, dangerous conditions, or other safety concerns.
This policy may be updated from time to time. The applicable policy is the version published on PeakUp at the time of booking, unless otherwise required by law.
